intro: Many Noida housing societies were built ten or more years ago, and their original play areas are now faded, cracked or simply too small for the number of families living there. Replacing that equipment is a different job from fitting out a new project. Residents use the space every day, the apartment owners' association has to approve the plan, and the work must fit around school hours and weekends.

FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 1,120 km from Noida, and delivers it to the National Capital Region by road. Our installation team or a dealer in the region takes out the old equipment and installs the new. Send us photos of the current play area, its measurements and the age groups using it. We will prepare a layout drawing that your committee can circulate to residents.

sections.h: Installing in a society where residents already live
sections.html:
Agree the installation days with the society office and close off the play area with a barrier while work is on. Grouted pieces need the concrete to set before use, so tell residents in advance when the area will reopen.

Old equipment often sits on cracked tiles or bare concrete. This is the right time to add rubber flooring in the safe play area. If space is short, one multi play system can replace several worn single pieces and give more play in the same footprint. Many societies upgrade their outdoor gym at the same time. See our outdoor gym equipment in Noida.

faq.q: Can you replace the old playground in our Noida society?
faq.a: Yes. Send us photos of the existing equipment and the space. We will suggest new pieces, plan the flooring and give you a layout drawing for your committee to approve.

faq.q: How long will the play area be closed during installation?
faq.a: That depends on the equipment and the installation method. Grouted pieces need the concrete to set before children use them. We will explain the steps when we confirm the layout.

faq.q: Do you also supply Greater Noida and Ghaziabad?
faq.a: Yes. We supply sites across the National Capital Region, including Ghaziabad and Faridabad, with dispatch by road from Vasai and installation by our team or a dealer.

intro: North Dum Dum, beside Kolkata's airport, has a large number of small private schools, nursery schools and coaching centres. For many of them, the outdoor play area is part of how they present themselves to parents. A themed play station, built around castles, robots, a circus or a forest, can give a small school a recognisable corner that children talk about at home.

FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures these themed structures at our factory in Vasai, about 1,650 km away, and sends them to West Bengal by road. Our installation team or a dealer in the region sets them up. Send us the size of your space, the age group and a photo or two. We will suggest a theme that suits the ground and send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

sections.html:
Our CoreCraft range includes several themes. Castle Crest uses turrets and towers, Robo Romp is built around robot figures, and Forestia and Clown Capade take their shapes from the jungle and the circus. Each combines slides, climbers and decks in one structure.

Pick the theme that matches your school's colours or name, then check the footprint against your ground. Kolkata's monsoon is heavy, so the base needs to drain well. If you would rather have something designed around Indian games and nature, look at our Funplay Originals.

faq.q: Can a small school in North Dum Dum fit a themed play station?
faq.a: Many themed structures come in more than one size. Send us your measurements and we will suggest one that fits, with the safe play area marked on the layout.

faq.q: Can the colours be matched to our school's branding?
faq.a: Yes. We offer more than 15 roto-moulded colour shades and can customise designs on request. Tell us your school colours when you send the enquiry.

faq.q: Do you install in Dum Dum, Baranagar and nearby areas?
faq.a: Yes. Equipment is dispatched by road from Vasai and installed by our own team or a dealer who covers the Kolkata area.

intro: In Ongole and across Prakasam district, children rarely come to a playground alone. A parent, grandparent or older sibling usually waits nearby, often for an hour or more in the evening when the heat eases. Yet many play areas we see have nowhere for those adults to sit except a kerb or a wall, and no shade over it.

FunPlay Systems makes playground equipment and garden furniture at our factory in Vasai, about 870 km away, and sends both to Ongole by road. Our installation team or a dealer in Andhra Pradesh installs them together. When you plan a school, park or society playground here, we suggest thinking about the adults as well. Share the site size, the age group and photos, and our layout drawing will show seating along with the safe play area.

sections.h: Seating and shade for the adults who wait
sections.html:
Benches belong at the edge of the play area, outside every safe play area but close enough for adults to see each piece. Our garden decor range includes benches, gazebos and pergolas made for outdoor use.

In coastal Andhra's summer, a gazebo or pergola makes the difference between a park that empties at four in the afternoon and one that stays busy. Bins near the seating keep the area clean. If the adults want to exercise while they wait, a few pieces from our Fun Fitness range can sit along the same path.

faq.q: Do you supply benches and gazebos as well as playground equipment?
faq.a: Yes. Our garden decor range includes benches, gazebos, pergolas and bins. We can place them on the same layout drawing as the play equipment.

faq.q: Where should benches go in a play area?
faq.a: Just outside the safe play areas, with a clear view of the equipment. Seats placed too close can become something children climb on or run into.

faq.q: Do you deliver to Ongole and Prakasam district?
faq.a: Yes. We dispatch by road from Vasai to Ongole and nearby towns such as Kavali and Narasaraopet, and our team or a dealer installs everything.

intro: Orai is the headquarters of Jalaun district in the Bundelkhand region of Uttar Pradesh, a hot, dry part of the state with long summers. Many schools here have one or two teachers watching a whole ground at break. That makes the layout of a playground important, because every piece should be visible from where the supervising adult stands.

FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 1,000 km away. We send it to Orai by road and our installation team or a dealer installs it. Send us a photo of your ground taken from the staff room or the main building, along with the size and the classes that will use it. We will plan the layout around that view and mark the safe play area for each piece.

sections.h: A layout one adult can supervise
sections.html:
Keep tall structures to the back of the play area and lower pieces in front, so nothing blocks the view from the building. Group the equipment in one zone instead of spreading it around the ground. A multi play system helps here, because it puts slides, steps and climbers in a single footprint that one person can watch.

Leave a clear path from the classroom door to the play area. Bundelkhand summers are severe, so plan a shaded spot for the teacher too. Put swings at one side, away from the path children use to cross the ground.

faq.q: How should we arrange equipment so one teacher can watch it?
faq.a: Group it in one zone, place taller pieces at the back and keep swings at the side. We plan the layout from a photo taken where the teacher usually stands.

faq.q: Do you supply schools in Jalaun district?
faq.a: Yes. We dispatch by road from Vasai to Orai and nearby towns, and our installation team or a dealer installs the equipment at your school.

faq.q: What materials suit Bundelkhand's heat?
faq.a: Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic handle heat and dust well. Shade over slides and decks keeps them comfortable for children in the hotter months.

intro: Ozhukarai is the largely residential municipality that wraps around Puducherry town on its western side. Its neighbourhood parks, school grounds and housing layouts are used by families of every age, often all at the same time in the evening. A municipal park here has to serve toddlers, older children and adults who come to walk or exercise.

FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground and fitness equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 1,110 km away. It travels to Puducherry by road, and our installation team or a local dealer puts it in. This coast gets most of its rain in the northeast monsoon, from October to December, and the sea air carries salt inland. Share the size of your park or ground and a few photos. We will suggest equipment for each age group and mark the safe play area on a layout drawing.

sections.h: Planning a park for every age group
sections.html:
In a public park, separate the play equipment into zones. Toddlers need low pieces such as spring riders close to seating. Older children need climbers, swings or a multi play system a short distance away, so the two groups do not collide.

Adults are best served by an outdoor gym along the walking track. Our outdoor gym equipment in Ozhukarai page covers that side. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic suit the salt air. Raise the base slightly so water drains away during the northeast monsoon.

faq.q: Can you plan a full park with play and gym equipment in Ozhukarai?
faq.a: Yes. We can place both on one layout drawing, with separate zones for toddlers, older children and adults, and seating between them.

faq.q: Does the coastal air affect playground equipment in Puducherry?
faq.a: Salt air is hard on untreated steel. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic resist it well, and rinsing the equipment with fresh water now and then helps.

faq.q: Who installs equipment in Puducherry?
faq.a: Our own installation team or a dealer in the region, using a self-standing or grouted method depending on the ground.

intro: Pali sits in the Marwar region of Rajasthan, a dry district known for its textile dyeing and printing units. Summers are very hot and dust storms are common before the monsoon. Fine dust is hard on anything that moves, and on a playground that means the springs, bearings and pivots in swings, see-saws, spring riders and merry-go-rounds.

FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 710 km from Pali, and sends it to Rajasthan by road. Our installation team or a dealer installs it at schools, societies, factory colonies and public gardens. Share your site size, the age group and a few photos. We will suggest pieces that suit the conditions and send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

sections.h: Looking after moving parts in a dusty climate
sections.html:
After a dust storm, wipe down the moving parts and listen for grinding or squeaks when the equipment is used. Those sounds usually mean dust has got into a bearing or a swing fitting. Our springs, bearings and spare parts carry a one-year warranty, and the frames and roto-moulded parts carry three years.

If maintenance staff are few, favour fixed pieces such as climbers and slides, which have no bearings at all. Add one merry-go-round or a swing set and check it each month. For adult fitness equipment, see our outdoor gym equipment in Pali.

faq.q: Does dust damage playground equipment in Pali?
faq.a: Dust mainly affects moving parts such as bearings and springs. Wiping them down after a storm and checking them regularly keeps them working smoothly.

faq.q: Which equipment needs the least maintenance?
faq.a: Fixed pieces such as climbers and slides have no moving parts and need little more than cleaning. Swings, see-saws and merry-go-rounds need periodic checks.

faq.q: Do you supply schools and colonies in Pali district?
faq.a: Yes. We dispatch by road from Vasai and install through our team or a dealer. Nearby cities such as Jodhpur and Udaipur are covered the same way.

intro: Pallavaram, on Chennai's south-western edge near the airport, has filled up with apartment complexes and gated layouts. In many of them, the play area is small and the evening crowd is large. When twenty children arrive at once, a single slide creates a queue. Equipment that several children can use together works better on these sites.

FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 1,050 km from Pallavaram, and brings it to Chennai by road. Our installation team or a dealer in Tamil Nadu installs it. In the state we have also installed a resort playground in Dindigul. Send us your space, the number of children likely to use it and some photos. We will suggest group play pieces and mark the safe play area on a layout drawing.

sections.h: Equipment that many children can use at once
sections.html:
A merry-go-round, a multi see-saw or a double swing lets several children play side by side. Our merry-go-rounds come in seated, standing and platform types. A multi play system with two slides and a climbing wall spreads children across the structure.

Many of the Funplay Originals designs are built for groups to play together. They also make a compact space feel larger. The northeast monsoon brings most of Chennai's rain, so plan a raised, drained base. You can see a Tamil Nadu installation at our Dindigul resort project.

faq.q: What equipment reduces queues in a busy society play area?
faq.a: Pieces that several children can use together, such as merry-go-rounds, multi see-saws, double swings and play systems with more than one slide.

faq.q: Do you supply Pallavaram and the southern suburbs of Chennai?
faq.a: Yes. We dispatch by road from Vasai and install through our own team or a dealer, across Chennai and its suburbs.

faq.q: Can a small apartment play area hold group equipment?
faq.a: Often, yes. A compact multi play system or a four-seater merry-go-round fits many small sites. Send us the measurements and we will check what fits.

intro: Goa's heavy monsoon runs from June to September, and in Panaji that shapes when a playground can be built. Digging, grouting and laying flooring in steady rain is slow and the concrete does not set well. Hotels, resorts and schools in and around the capital usually plan their installation for the dry months, so the play area is ready when the tourist season or the school term begins.

FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 440 km from Panaji, and sends it down the coast by road. Our installation team or a dealer installs it. Salt air along the Mandovi is hard on bare steel, so we use galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic. Tell us your site size, the age group and your target opening date, and we will send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

sections.h: Timing the installation around the monsoon
sections.html:
Work backwards from the date you want the play area open. Leave time to approve the layout and the quote, for us to manufacture and dispatch, and for installation in dry weather. A hotel that wants its play area ready for the season should start talking to us well before the rains end.

For resorts, a structure from our NexLev series gives a striking centrepiece, while a few swings and spring riders suit a smaller garden. Rinse the equipment with fresh water from time to time to clear salt deposits.

faq.q: Can playground equipment be installed in Goa during the monsoon?
faq.a: It is possible on some sites, but heavy rain slows the work and affects grouting. Most buyers in Panaji plan the installation for the dry months.

faq.q: What equipment suits a resort or hotel in Goa?
faq.a: A feature structure for older children, plus swings and spring riders for small ones. We will suggest pieces that match the space and the look of the property.

faq.q: Do you supply the rest of Goa as well as Panaji?
faq.a: Yes. We dispatch by road from Vasai to sites across Goa, and our installation team or a dealer installs the equipment.

intro: Panchkula was planned as a city of sectors at the foot of the Shivalik hills, beside Chandigarh, and nearly every sector has its own green park. Those parks are used by walkers in the morning and by families in the evening. More and more resident associations here want a children's playground and an outdoor gym in the same park.

FunPlay Systems makes both at our factory in Vasai, about 1,320 km from Panchkula, and sends them to Haryana by road. Our installation team or a dealer in the north installs them. Winters here are cold, summers are hot, and the monsoon is heavy, so we use galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic throughout. Send us a plan or photos of your park, and we will mark the playground, the gym and the safe play areas on one layout drawing.

sections.h: Combining play and fitness in a sector park
sections.html:
Keep the children's area and the adult gym in separate zones, with a path or a planted strip between them. Gym machines have moving arms and pedals that small children should not wander into. Place the gym along the walking track, where most adults already are.

For the children, a multi play system with a swing set beside it suits most sector parks. For adults, see our outdoor gym equipment in Panchkula. Benches between the two zones let parents keep an eye on both. On sloping ground near the hills, level the base before installation.

faq.q: Can one park in Panchkula have both a playground and an outdoor gym?
faq.a: Yes. We plan them as separate zones on one layout, with space between the gym machines and the children's equipment.

faq.q: How does the equipment cope with cold winters?
faq.a: Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic handle the cold and damp of a north Indian winter well. Check the moving parts after the monsoon and again before winter.

faq.q: Do you install in Panchkula, Chandigarh and nearby towns?
faq.a: Yes. We dispatch by road from Vasai and install through our team or a dealer. Ambala and Patiala are covered the same way.

intro: A playground quotation can look simple, a list of items and a total, but two offers with the same items can mean very different things. Buyers in Panihati and the towns along the Hooghly north of Kolkata often send us a competing quote and ask why the prices differ. The answer is usually in the details the quote leaves out.

FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our own factory in Vasai, about 1,650 km away, and sends it to West Bengal by road. Our installation team or a dealer in the region installs it. With every quote we send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked. Share your site size, the age group and photos, and we will prepare one for your school, club or society.

sections.h: What to check in a playground quotation
sections.html:
• Materials: whether the frames are galvanised steel and whether plastic parts are roto-moulded.
  • Installation: whether it is included, and whether the pieces are self-standing or grouted.
  • Warranty: what is covered and for how long, in writing.

Our warranty is three years on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope, and one year on springs, bearings and spare parts. A quote should also say whether rubber flooring is included. Ask for a layout drawing, because it shows whether the equipment fits your ground with its safe play area. You can browse our CoreCraft range before you compare.

faq.q: Why do playground quotes from different suppliers vary so much?
faq.a: Materials, installation and warranty are often not stated the same way. Compare galvanised against painted steel, check whether installation is included, and ask for the warranty in writing.

faq.q: Does your quote include installation in Panihati?
faq.a: We state installation clearly in every quote. Our installation team or a dealer in West Bengal installs the equipment after it is dispatched from Vasai.

faq.q: Do you send a layout drawing with the quote?
faq.a: Yes. The layout drawing shows where each piece goes and marks its safe play area, so you can check the fit before you approve anything.

intro: Panipat is known as a city of weavers, and its mills turn yarn and old textiles into rugs, blankets and furnishings sold around the world. People here understand rope, fibre and wear better than most. So it is fair that Panipat buyers ask how the rope and nets on a playground climber are made, and how long they will last.

FunPlay Systems makes climbers, nets and play structures at our factory in Vasai, about 1,190 km from Panipat. We send the equipment to Haryana by road, and our installation team or a dealer in the north installs it. Schools, societies, industrial colonies and parks make up most of our work in the region. Share your space, the age group and photos, and we will send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

sections.html:
Rope climbers and nets let children climb in a way that a ladder does not. They test balance, grip and planning, and several children can use them at once. Our climber range includes pieces such as the Straight Net and the Net Rock Climber.

Play rope carries our three-year warranty against manufacturing defects. Check knots and fixings during routine maintenance, and look for worn fibres where children grip most. A frayed strand is easy to replace early and harder to deal with once it gives way. North Indian summers and winters are both hard on materials, so keep nets clear of standing water after rain.

faq.q: Is the play rope on climbers covered by warranty?
faq.a: Yes. Play rope is covered for three years against manufacturing defects, when the equipment is installed and maintained as per our instructions.

faq.q: What age group suits net climbers?
faq.a: Most net climbers suit primary-age children and older. For younger children we suggest lower climbers. We will check the age group for each piece you select.

faq.q: Do you deliver to Panipat and nearby towns?
faq.a: Yes. We dispatch by road from Vasai to Panipat, Karnal, Sonipat and nearby towns, and our team or a dealer installs the equipment.

intro: Panvel is about 50 km from our factory in Vasai, which makes it one of the closest places we supply. The area has grown fast into large townships and gated complexes, many of them built in phases with several small play pockets spread across the layout instead of one central playground.

FunPlay Systems has made outdoor playground equipment since 2002 and has installed a playground for Raymond in Thane, not far from here. For a township with more than one play area, the planning matters as much as the equipment. Share the master plan or the amenity drawing, the size of each pocket and the number of homes in each phase. We will suggest equipment for each pocket and send layout drawings with the safe play area marked.

sections.h: Several play pockets in one township
sections.html:
Give each pocket a different job. One can be a toddler area with spring riders and a short slide, near the buildings with young families. Another can hold a larger multi play system for older children, further from the windows. A third can take swings and a merry-go-round.

This spreads children across the township and gives them a reason to visit more than one area. Use one colour family across all pockets so the township looks consistent. The Konkan monsoon is heavy, so each pocket needs drainage. See our work for Raymond, Thane.

faq.q: How close is your factory to Panvel?
faq.a: Our factory is in Vasai, about 50 km away. Equipment travels by road and our installation team sets it up at your site.

faq.q: Can you plan play areas for a phased township?
faq.a: Yes. Send us the master plan or amenity drawing, and we will suggest equipment for each play pocket and phase, with a layout drawing for each.

faq.q: What should a builder in Panvel send for a quote?
faq.a: The amenity drawing, the size of each play area, the expected age groups and photos of the site if it is ready. We then prepare layouts and a quote.
